skills.name: Rust project basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read Cargo.toml for deps and features.
2. Patch code with ownership rules in mind.
3. Build via process.exec cargo check (if available) else note unavailability.
4. Fix warnings first errors second.
5. Summarize changes.

skills.name: Rust unsafe audit
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for unsafe blocks.
2. Justify each: FFI, perf, invariants (comments).
3. Wrap with safe abstractions where possible.
4. Test edge inputs via a harness.
5. Document remaining risks.

skills.name: Go modules workflow
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read go.mod.
2. Pin versions; explain MVS choices.
3. Run builds/tests via process.exec go commands when available.
4. Fix vet findings.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Go concurrency patterns
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for goroutines and channels.
2. Check for races (shared state) by reading.
3. Add contexts for cancellation.
4. Propose race detector runs (process.exec).
5. Document invariants.

skills.name: Swift/iOS project reading
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read Package.swift/project files.
2. Map modules and targets.
3. Note API usage needing review (web.search for lifecycle).
4. Summarize architecture.
5. Record open questions.

skills.name: .NET solution navigation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the .sln and csproj files.
2. Map project references (python.run_file).
3. Identify entry points.
4. Note package versions.
5. Summarize structure.

skills.name: C# async review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for async/await patterns.
2. Flag async-void and .Result/.Wait() deadlocks.
3. Check ConfigureAwait usage in libraries.
4. Propose fixes with file.patch.
5. Note test needs.

skills.name: Express app review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read app entry and routes.
2. Check middleware order (auth before routes).
3. Flag unvalidated inputs.
4. Recommend validation libs.
5. Summarize findings.

skills.name: Node streams correctness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for pipe/pipeline usage.
2. Prefer pipeline() for error propagation.
3. Check backpressure handling.
4. Propose fixes.
5. Test via node.exec script.

skills.name: asyncio review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for asyncio usage.
2. Flag blocking calls inside coroutines.
3. Check task cancellation handling.
4. Propose to_thread for blocking IO.
5. Verify with a python.run_file smoke.

skills.name: Type hints adoption
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick a module; annotate public functions first.
2. Use mypy-style checks conceptually (python.run_file if available).
3. Fix revealed bugs, not just annotations.
4. Keep runtime unchanged.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: pytest suite design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list tests; note fixtures.
2. Parametrize cases; keep tests isolated.
3. Mock external edges.
4. Run via python.run_file -m pytest when available.
5. Report coverage focus.

skills.name: JUnit 5 patterns
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list existing tests.
2. Use @Nested for grouping; lifecycle per class.
3. Assert with messages.
4. Run with gradle.exec.
5. Report counts.

skills.name: Mockito usage
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search mock usage.
2. Prefer constructor injection for seams.
3. Verify interactions only when behavior matters.
4. Keep stubs minimal.
5. Run with gradle.exec.

skills.name: Custom Gradle tasks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read build.gradle.kts task blocks.
2. Add small, cacheable tasks.
3. Wire inputs/outputs for up-to-date checks.
4. Verify with gradle.exec taskName.
5. Document usage.

skills.name: Strict shell scripts
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the script.
2. Add set -euo pipefail and traps.
3. Quote everything (review via grep).
4. Dry-run harness via process.exec bash -n.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Makefile best practices
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the Makefile.
2. Add .PHONY correctly.
3. Refactor repeated recipes into patterns.
4. Verify via make.exec -n (dry run).
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Modern CMake targets
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read CMakeLists.
2. Prefer target_* commands over globals.
3. Set compile features instead of standards flags where possible.
4. Verify configure via make.exec flow.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Sanitizer builds
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Patch build flags for ASan/UBSan (file.patch).
2. Build via clang.exec.
3. Run the harness; read reports.
4. Fix first root causes.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Core dump triage
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect the core and binary (process.exec).
2. Load in gdb (process.exec) and get backtrace.
3. Map to source (file.read).
4. Identify the faulting line.
5. Propose fix.

skills.name: Memory error hunting
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Build with debug symbols (clang.exec).
2. Run under valgrind via process.exec (if available).
3. Triage definite leaks first.
4. Fix and re-run.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Regex dialect awareness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify the regex engine in use (file.search imports).
2. Test the pattern across dialects with python.run_file.
3. Adjust syntax accordingly.
4. Document dialect notes.
5. Verify with samples.

skills.name: Date/time pitfalls
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search date parsing/formatting.
2. Prefer explicit zones and ISO parsing.
3. Test DST boundaries via python.run_file.
4. Fix naive datetime usage.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Money and floats
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search float usage on money.
2. Convert to decimal/integer minor units with file.patch.
3. Round explicitly at boundaries.
4. Add tests for rounding (gradle.exec/python.run_file).
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Serialization safety
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for deserialization entry points.
2. Prefer schema-validated formats.
3. Restrict types (no arbitrary classes).
4. Add size/depth caps.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Parameterized queries everywhere
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search string-concatenated SQL.
2. Replace with parameters/prepared statements (file.patch).
3. Add a lint rule mentally for the codebase.
4. Test queries still work.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Output encoding defense
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Locate render paths (file.search).
2. Apply context-aware encoding helpers.
3. Add CSP as defense-in-depth.
4. Test with benign markers.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Centralized authorization
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map ad-hoc checks (file.search).
2. Introduce a policy module.
3. Route checks through it (file.patch).
4. Add policy tests.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Secrets in code cleanup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Scan the repo (python.run_file patterns).
2. Revoke/rotate anything found (user action list).
3. Purge history only with user approval.
4. Add scanning to CI (doc).
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Dependency pinning discipline
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read manifests for floating ranges.
2. Pin to exact/minor-locked versions (file.patch).
3. Commit lockfiles.
4. Verify reproducible build once.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Alert design basics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map SLIs from logs/metrics (file.read).
2. Draft SLO-based alerts.
3. Avoid per-error spam.
4. Document runbook links.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Structured logging
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search print/log statements.
2. Introduce structured fields (json logs) via a helper.
3. Correlate with request ids.
4. Redact sensitive fields.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Client SDK design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read API usage scattered in code (file.search).
2. Design a small client class.
3. Migrate call sites (file.patch).
4. Add retry/timeouts inside.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Toggle cleanup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search flag checks.
2. List flags with dates (file.write).
3. Remove expired ones (file.patch).
4. Verify behavior.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Performance budgets
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define budgets for key flows (file.write).
2. Measure with timing harnesses (python.run_file).
3. Flag regressions in review.
4. Track trends.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Legacy code archaeology
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read entry points; trace one flow end-to-end.
2. Note dead branches and TODOs (file.search).
3. Draw the flow in text.
4. List safe cleanup candidates.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: API deprecation flow
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Announce via docs/changelog (file.patch).
2. Add Sunset headers if web.
3. Log usage of deprecated paths.
4. Set removal date.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Test data factories
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Create factory helpers (file.write).
2. Randomize with fixed seeds.
3. Scope cleanup after tests.
4. Use in suites (gradle.exec/pytest).
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Contract-first APIs
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write the OpenAPI spec first (file.write).
2. Generate/validate handlers against it (python.run_file check).
3. Keep docs in sync.
4. Test via contract tests.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Light chaos checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Inject latency/errors at boundaries (test env only).
2. Observe retry/circuit behaviors (logs).
3. Record weaknesses.
4. Fix with backoff/timeout changes.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: Accessibility pass
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read layouts for contentDescription/labels.
2. Check focus order and touch targets.
3. Fix gaps (file.patch).
4. Verify via androidreadscreen semantics.
5. Summarize.

skills.name: i18n readiness
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Extract hardcoded strings (file.search).
2. Move to resources (file.patch).
3. Check plural/format handling.
4. Test with pseudo-locale strings.
5. Summarize.
